content:
Field
Description
customerIDString
Unique ID assigned by CrowdStrike for each customer.
offset
Starts at offset: 0. Each new event (AuthActivityAuditEvent, DetectionSummaryEvent, CustomerIOCEvent, UserActivityAuditEvent)
would increase the offset counter by one. When reconnecting to the Falcon Streaming API, you can specify the offset value to tell the
API the starting point where you’d like to receive the events. If omitted, the API would return all previous detection Summary or
authentication events starting with offset=0.
eventType
Name of the event.
eventCreationTime
Time when this event was generated in Unix epoch time.
